title: 10 Late-Night Runs That Explain University of California-Santa Barbara
description: Ten currently listed food and convenience destinations in Isla Vista with evening or overnight availability documented by UCSB’s A.S. Pardall Center.

cards.title: 7-Eleven
cards.subtitle: 6545 Trigo Rd, Isla Vista
cards.notes: Use this 24-hour convenience stop when you need food or basics outside restaurant schedules; confirm stocked items in person.
cards.short_summary: A documented round-the-clock convenience option in Isla Vista.
cards.evidence_claim: UCSB A.S. Pardall Center lists the 7-Eleven at 6545 Trigo Rd as open 24 hours Monday through Sunday.
cards.access_notes: Listed as open 24 hours Monday–Sunday; visit during publicly open retail hours.

cards.title: Deja Vu
cards.subtitle: 966 Embarcadero del Mar B, Isla Vista
cards.notes: Choose this burger-and-food counter for a late meal; weekday and weekend closing times differ, so check the listed day first.
cards.short_summary: A food counter listed into the early morning on selected nights.
cards.evidence_claim: UCSB A.S. Pardall Center lists Deja Vu at 966 Embarcadero del Mar B until 1:30 a.m. Sunday–Wednesday and 2:30 a.m. Thursday–Saturday.
cards.access_notes: Listed hours: 11 a.m.–1:30 a.m. Sunday–Wednesday; 11 a.m.–2:30 a.m. Thursday; 10 a.m.–2:30 a.m. Friday–Saturday.

cards.title: Domino's Pizza
cards.subtitle: 955 Embarcadero del Mar, Isla Vista
cards.notes: Plan a pickup or delivery order around the day-specific closing time; the listed Friday and Saturday window runs latest.
cards.short_summary: A pizza option with listed service to 3 a.m. on Friday and Saturday.
cards.evidence_claim: UCSB A.S. Pardall Center lists Domino’s Pizza at 955 Embarcadero del Mar until 2 a.m. Sunday–Thursday and 3 a.m. Friday–Saturday.
cards.access_notes: Listed hours: 11 a.m.–2 a.m. Sunday–Thursday and 11 a.m.–3 a.m. Friday–Saturday.

cards.title: Freebirds
cards.subtitle: 879 Embarcadero del Norte, Isla Vista
cards.notes: Use the listed 11 p.m. closing time as a cutoff for an evening food run; check the venue before leaving for changes.
cards.short_summary: An Isla Vista burrito destination listed through 11 p.m. daily.
cards.evidence_claim: UCSB A.S. Pardall Center lists Freebirds at 879 Embarcadero del Norte as open 11 a.m.–11 p.m. Monday through Sunday.
cards.access_notes: Listed daily hours are 11 a.m.–11 p.m.

cards.title: International Market
cards.subtitle: 6551 Trigo Rd #3, Isla Vista
cards.notes: Stop by before the midnight listed close for groceries or prepared-food needs; allow time to select and check out.
cards.short_summary: A market listed open until midnight every day.
cards.evidence_claim: UCSB A.S. Pardall Center lists International Market at 6551 Trigo Rd #3 as open 11 a.m.–12 a.m. Monday through Sunday.
cards.access_notes: Listed daily hours are 11 a.m.–12 a.m.

cards.title: IV Deli Mart
cards.subtitle: 6553 Pardall Rd, Isla Vista
cards.notes: Make this a Friday or Saturday convenience stop when you need a later option; other listed nights end at 11 p.m.
cards.short_summary: A neighborhood deli listed until midnight on Friday and Saturday.
cards.evidence_claim: UCSB A.S. Pardall Center lists IV Deli Mart at 6553 Pardall Rd until 11 p.m. Sunday–Thursday and midnight Friday–Saturday.
cards.access_notes: Listed hours: 8 a.m.–11 p.m. Sunday–Thursday and 8 a.m.–12 a.m. Friday–Saturday.

cards.title: PokeCeviche
cards.subtitle: 901 Embarcadero del Mar #102, Isla Vista
cards.notes: Time a poke or ceviche order to the listed midnight weekday close or 1 a.m. weekend close; verify availability before heading over.
cards.short_summary: A seafood-focused option with late listed hours in Isla Vista.
cards.evidence_claim: UCSB A.S. Pardall Center lists PokeCeviche at 901 Embarcadero del Mar #102 until midnight Sunday–Thursday and 1 a.m. Friday–Saturday.
cards.access_notes: Listed hours: 11 a.m.–12 a.m. Sunday–Thursday and 11 a.m.–1 a.m. Friday–Saturday.

cards.title: Teddy Rice
cards.subtitle: 966 Embarcadero del Mar STE A, Isla Vista
cards.notes: Schedule a weekend food stop here before its listed 2 a.m. close; the Monday–Thursday schedule ends at 10 p.m.
cards.short_summary: A food destination listed late on Friday through Sunday.
cards.evidence_claim: UCSB A.S. Pardall Center lists Teddy Rice at 966 Embarcadero del Mar STE A until 10 p.m. Monday–Thursday and 2 a.m. Friday–Sunday.
cards.access_notes: Listed hours: 11 a.m.–10 p.m. Monday–Thursday and 11 a.m.–2 a.m. Friday–Sunday.

cards.title: Wingstop
cards.subtitle: 888 Embarcadero del Norte, Goleta
cards.notes: Use the daily midnight closing time for a late dinner plan, and leave room for ordering and pickup before closing.
cards.short_summary: A wings restaurant listed until midnight every day.
cards.evidence_claim: UCSB A.S. Pardall Center lists Wingstop at 888 Embarcadero del Norte as open 10:30 a.m.–12 a.m. Monday through Sunday.
cards.access_notes: Listed daily hours are 10:30 a.m.–12 a.m.

cards.title: Woodstock's Pizza
cards.subtitle: 928 Embarcadero del Norte, Isla Vista
cards.notes: Use the day-specific schedule for a late pizza order; Friday and Saturday are listed later than the rest of the week.
cards.short_summary: A pizza destination listed until 1 a.m. on Friday and Saturday.
cards.evidence_claim: UCSB A.S. Pardall Center lists Woodstock’s Pizza at 928 Embarcadero del Norte until midnight Monday–Thursday, 1 a.m. Friday–Saturday, and 11 p.m. Sunday.
cards.access_notes: Listed hours: 11 a.m.–12 a.m. Monday–Thursday, 11 a.m.–1 a.m. Friday–Saturday, and 11 a.m.–11 p.m. Sunday.
